target_customer: US real estate operators and property managers (company site)
problem: Real estate businesses juggle many entities and properties across banking, cards and expense tools; Glep offers one spend and banking platform with property level accounts and an AI finance agent.
business_model: B2B fintech: card interchange and software fees via a partner bank (Core Bank, per company site)
product_category: Spend management and business banking for real estate

founders.name: Andrew Airelobhegbe
previous_startups: Lenco (pan-African business digital bank, co-founder and CEO)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as CEO and co-founder of Glep and of Lenco; education and other employers not listed.

founders.name: Impact Airelobhegbe
founders.background_notes: Listed on the Glep YC page with Lenco affiliation only; Guardian Nigeria profile also calls him a Lenco co-founder. Role at Glep not stated.

competitors.name: Prospa
competitors.what: Nigerian small business banking and software platform, a rival to the Lenco business banking model that the Winter 2022 YC team started with

technical_complexity.rationale: Cards, bank accounts and payment rails delivered through a partner bank, plus accounting integrations; standard fintech engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Vertical focus and integrations add some lock in, but spend management is a crowded category with well funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources I could open.

market_need_then: Pan African SME banking gaps motivated Lenco at the time of the batch; the US real estate spend pitch is a later positioning with no dated demand evidence found.

branding.domain_note: Uses glep.com, an exact .com per the company site.

identity.mascot_or_character: Aida, an AI finance agent product persona
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language focused on real estate operators

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand was found; searches for Glep returned unrelated results.

outcome_analysis: Glep is listed as Active with 30 people, but the record is murky. The YC page names only the Lenco founders and gives a founding year of 2026, which conflicts with the Winter 2022 batch, and funding details for Glep are not public. It is unclear whether Glep is a pivot, a sister company or a relabeling of the Winter 2022 Lenco team, so no success or failure story can be told.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a seed of about 125K USD for Glep with details paywalled. Search results show Lenco (YC W22) with a 2.0M USD seed on 2022-03-23 per SeedTable, but that is Lenco and was not attributed to Glep. Competitor listed is for the Lenco era business, not the current real estate positioning. No outcome news found for Glep. Founding year on YC page (2026) conflicts with batch; recorded as null.
